_comment: THE MOTOR SITS AT THE END OF THE DRUM, and that is what makes this recipe reachable.
This was byte-identical to pulverizer.json from #197 - same pattern, same key, same five steel
offcuts, one motor and three plating. Two recipes that accept the same grid are one recipe: the
map yields one of them and the other simply cannot be crafted, with no error and a JEI page that
says it works. One of these two machines had been uncraftable in survival for four releases.
The cost is deliberately unchanged - same items, same counts, only the arrangement moves - so this
is a reachability fix rather than a balance one. The arrangement is the honest one for each
machine: a trommel is a rotating drum driven from one END, while a pulverizer's rotor is central,
which is the SMS row the pulverizer keeps.
